model.name: R20.23: Every scenario type shows a source file:line link in the detail view.
model.description: EVERY scenario type's detail view MUST show a clickable source file:line link — the file and line where the unit is defined/implemented. This is the universal base; per-type specializations (R20.24-27) add additional links. CLICKABLE in detail drawer: clicking the source file:line link NAVIGATES to the file browser at that file+line (Monaco opens at line). Not just displayed text — actual clickable navigation.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "each type has a link to a source file:line, classes to the puml file and the resulting svg preview, same as methods to the puml AND the ts code, same as tests and gates"

intendedChain.useCase: detailView.sourceLink — every type renders a clickable source file:line
intendedChain.test: RED: open R20.23 detail → assert source link(s) present + clickable. Links must be CLICKABLE (navigate on click, not just text). Currently FAILS.

architectDesign.pattern: Every scenario type already has model.sourceFile (populated by fill-source-locations.ts). The detail view already calls renderSourceLink(sourceFile, sourceLine) via detail-children.ts. R20.23 is ALREADY IMPLEMENTED for types that have sourceFile populated. Gap: some types have empty sourceFile. Fix = extend fill-source-locations.ts to cover all types, OR confirm which types naturally have no source (Sprint, Room).
architectDesign.gate: Open each type in detail → source link rendered if sourceFile exists. Types without source (Sprint, Room) show no link (by design).
